item_name: Rothco Star of Life EMT Watch Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s 'Star of Life' EMT Watch Cap is designed to keep your head warm with a lightweight acrylic construction.
description: Rothco’s 'Star of Life' EMT Watch Cap is designed to keep your head warm with a lightweight acrylic construction. The knit caps are great for EMS personnel working long shifts in cold weather climates with a double layer construction for added warmth. With a one size fits most design, the star of life symbol cap is made to be worn by anyone.
